release_rules: Do not multiply PPAC half-year sales by two or treat it as fiscal-year energy consumption.
Do not sum selected PPAC products as total POL or treat Kerala refinery throughput as Kerala final use.
Do not add EMC old FY2019-20 total to FY2024-25 KSEBL electricity annual number.
Do not multiply integer-rounded shares by rounded total to publish measured fuel Mtoe.
Transport 1% in EMC refers only to electricity, not transport share of total final energy.
Do not infer import dependence from fuel mix; imported coal is a source label, not an audited border flow share.
Never turn announced LNG or refinery capacity into fuel energy consumption.
FY2030 EMC projection remains externally authored sensitivity, not actual observation or Kerala2040 model output.
